metadata.coverage_note: Wave 9 coverage: 89 companies (12-company pilot of 2026-09-19, 10-company wave 2 of 2026-09-20, 10-company wave 3 of 2026-09-20, 10-company wave 4 of 2026-09-20, 7-company wave 5 of 2026-09-21, 10-company wave 6 of 2026-09-21, 10-company wave 7 of 2026-09-21, 10-company wave 8 of 2026-09-21, 10-company wave 9 of 2026-09-21; INTC excluded: 2026 proxy carries no Inline XBRL; KKR/BX 402(v)-exempt. Full S&P 500 rollout pending.)
metadata.methodology: Values transcribed from the rendered Pay versus Performance table in each company's latest DEF 14A filing, using per-ticker manual column maps verified against the filing HTML. The four compensation columns were cross-checked against Inline XBRL facts (ecd:PeoTotalCompAmt, PeoActuallyPaidCompAmt, NonPeoNeoAvgTotalCompAmt, NonPeoNeoAvgCompActuallyPaidAmt); all 438 company-years passed with zero rejections. TSR columns show the value of an initial fixed $100 investment. Units vary by filer and are recorded per company; compensation normalized to dollars. Fiscal-year filers (PG, HD, COST, ORCL, WMT, CRM, DIS, CSCO, INTU, PANW, NKE) show the year as filed. JNJ files two peer TSR series (S&P Pharmaceuticals and S&P Healthcare Equipment); AMZN files two peer TSR series (NYSE Technology and S&P Retail). PLTR lists no company-selected measure; its CSM fields are null. NOW files two peer TSR series (2025 peer group and prior peer group); Citi (C) files net income in $B. C (2021), TMUS (2025), NKE (2025-2026) show multiple PEOs with per-executive XBRL member verification. MU (fiscal filer, Aug yr-end), CAT (CEO change May 1 2025, Creed+Umpleby 2025), AMAT (fiscal filer, Oct yr-end; neg. PEO CAP 2022), MRK (net income filed in $000s; Davis+Frazier 2021), PM (Calantzopoulos+Olczak 2021; CSM = currency-neutral adj. diluted EPS growth %), RTX (Calio+Hayes 2024-2025; neg. Hayes CAP 2023), GEV (2 PvP years only, spun off Apr 2024). Wave 6 notes: SBUX 2024 three-PEO year (Narasimhan/Ruggeri interim/Niccol); WDAY multi-PEO co-CEO history, FY2026 Eschenbach CAP -$17.7M; CRWD fiscal labels FY2022-FY2026; ROST net income and CSM filed in $000s, kept as filed; CRWD net income/CSM in $K, kept as filed; ROST XBRL contexts end Jan of N+1; EQIX 2024 dual-PEO; USB 2025 dual-PEO; FICO CSM is relative TSR percentile (%); SBUX TSR headers read '3-Year' as filed. Wave 7 notes: MS 2025 TSR measured from Dec 31, 2020 while 2021-2024 use Dec 31, 2019 (filing footnote 4); MS 2023 non-CEO NEO figures carry footnote 7 (one-time Staking Awards); PH fiscal FY2022-FY2026 (Williams thru 2022, Parmentier since 2023); WBD 2022 CEO CAP negative (-$40.93M); LRCX fiscal FY2021-FY2025, net income filed in $000s kept as filed; GS 2025 CEO CAP $309.8M (PSU/Retention RSU fair-value remeasurements); BLK 2022 negative CEO CAP (-$5.79M) and negative avg non-CEO CAP (-$12.46M); TMO 2022 negative CAP both CEO (-$4.70M) and avg non-CEO NEO (-$0.64M); CMCSA 2022/2024 negative CEO CAP (-$4.09M/-$1.59M), net income and CSM in $B kept as filed; PYPL 2023 dual-PEO (Schulman/Chriss), negative CAPs Chriss 2025 (-$7.47M), Schulman 2022 (-$87.00M), avg non-PEO 2022 (-$13.36M) and 2025 (-$2.42M). Wave 8 notes: DELL fiscal FY2022-FY2026 (Michael S. Dell all years; SCT==CAP every year, no equity grants/pension); DELL FY2023 avg non-CEO NEO CAP negative (-$5.08M, split parens); DELL additional measure Non-GAAP net revenue ($M) kept in csm_addl; VZ 2025 dual-PEO (Vestberg Jan-Oct, Daniel Schulman from Oct 4, 2025; Schulman sign-on equity $32.8M); ACN FY2021-FY2025 (Julie Sweet); PFE 2023 negative CAP CEO (-$62.1M) and avg non-CEO NEO (-$9.47M); QCOM FY2021-FY2025 dual-PEO 2021 (Mollenkopf thru Jun 30, 2021, Cristiano R. Amon from Jun 30, 2021); UNP 2023 dual-PEO (Fritz thru Aug 14, 2023, Jim Vena since); HON 2023 dual-PEO (Adamczyk, Kapur since 2023); LIN interleaved First/Second CEO columns (Stephen F. Angel thru Mar 2022, Sanjiv Lamba since; LIN 2025 PEO facts omit member tags, fell back to untagged candidate matching); TJX FY2022-FY2026 (Ernie Herrman; CSM MIP Incentive Pre-Tax Income in $K, net income in $K kept as filed); MCD (Chris Kempczinski; 2024 CSM Annual EPS Growth -2.0%). All 50 wave-8 company-years passed the strict candidate-presence Inline XBRL audit. Wave 9 notes: ANET 2021-2025 (Jayshree Ullal; 2022 avg non-PEO CAP -$785,576); AMGN 2021-2025 (Robert A. Bradway; CSM Non-GAAP EPS ($)); TXN 2021-2025 dual-PEO 2023 (Templeton/Ilan, member-tag verified); SNDK FY2025 only (inaugural standalone proxy post-Feb 2025 separation; CSM Revenue ($M); net income -$1,641M); KLAC FY2021-FY2025 (Richard Wallace; CSM Free Cash Flow Margin (%); FY2025 avg non-PEO CAP -$383,111; net income in $K kept as filed); IBM 2021-2025 (Arvind Krishna); SCHW 2021-2025 (Bettinger thru 2024, Wurster 2025; net income in $000s kept as filed); PEP 2021-2025 (Ramon L. Laguarta; 2025 CSM em-dash parsed null); ABT 2021-2025 (Robert B. Ford); GILD 2021-2025 (Daniel O'Day; CSM Net Product Sales ($M)). All 46 wave-9 company-years passed the strict candidate-presence Inline XBRL audit.
